verdict.rationale: Every core document-processing capability shown in the UI also has a documented API or SDK path: conversion, structured extraction, segmentation, form filling, track-changes and DOCX creation, pipelines, file management, agent processors and schema generation. The Forge playground looks like a front end over those same processors. However, account-level functions such as enabling 2FA and team 2FA enforcement are documented only as dashboard actions, and no explicit API/UI parity statement or OpenAPI spec was found. Missing for 10: an explicit parity commitment, API coverage of account, security and team administration settings, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent corroboration of parity.
